name: PixaInterface
title: PixaInterface User Manual
scope: Product workflows, account access, recovery and updates. Source-backed tool tours are included where a registered tool catalog is connected; this is not a complete reference for every editor command.

chapters.title: Start a first project
chapters.body: Create a small design with one screen or frame. Decide what the person using that screen should notice first.

chapters.title: Make a first edit
chapters.body: Add shapes, text and interface elements, then adjust alignment and spacing. Use a consistent visual hierarchy.

chapters.title: Keep your work organized
chapters.body: Name screens and layers clearly. Keep related elements together and reuse consistent styling where the editor supports it.

chapters.title: Save and export
chapters.body: Save the editable design and preview the screens you plan to share. Check exported assets at their intended display size. If the device access refresh fails, keep the app open and use Save recovery copy to choose a destination. Reconnect before closing if you have unfinished text fields or background operations. Open the recovered native files in the editor after reconnecting; retain the original files.

chapters.title: Your account
chapters.body: Use Your account in the Pixa footer to connect this device. Pixa is free early access with no card requirement and no scheduled account expiration. Only approve the code displayed on your own device. Device access refreshes online; a disconnected, revoked or signed-out device must reconnect. Your files remain local.

chapters.title: Updates
chapters.body: Use Updates in the Pixa footer to check the Pixa publisher feed. On Mac, download the candidate, save your work and choose Install and restart. The app checks the installer digest, Apple publisher signature, bundle identity and Gatekeeper before replacement. A canceled editor-close prompt cancels the pending restart. Windows and Linux open the Pixa download page. No update is offered until a matching publisher release exists.

chapters.title: Find your way around
chapters.body: The menu bar and editor panels contain the main controls. Use the existing workspace controls to show a hidden panel. Manual and Quick tour in the Pixa footer reopen this help without changing the project.

chapters.title: Undo and safe experiments
chapters.body: Use Undo to reverse a normal document edit, and Redo to restore it. Keep an original project or duplicate before destructive operations. Undo does not reverse an external file deletion, a published upload or every background operation.

chapters.title: Linked files and portability
chapters.body: An editable project may refer to media, fonts, textures or other external files. Keep those resources alongside your project in a stable folder. Copy the complete folder when moving computers and reopen it before removing the original.

chapters.title: Working with another application
chapters.body: Save a native editable copy before exporting an interchange format. Features such as effects, fonts and linked resources may differ in another application. Reopen exported files in the destination application before relying on them.

chapters.title: Recovery and backups
chapters.body: Save regularly and keep a separate backup of important projects and original media. Recovery copies contain committed project state; unfinished text fields, external files and background tasks may need separate attention. Restore into a new project or folder rather than overwriting the original.

chapters.title: Troubleshooting
chapters.body: For missing content, check the active document, selected object, visible panels, layers and linked-file paths. For account problems, reconnect in Your account. For failed updates, keep the existing application and use the verified Pixa download page; do not disable operating-system security checks.

tools.title: Move
tools.body: Select and reposition objects on the canvas. Use the properties panel for exact values.

tools.title: Scale
tools.body: Resize a selection proportionally, including supported visual properties.

tools.title: Hand tool
tools.body: Pan the canvas without changing the design.

tools.title: Frame
tools.body: Draw a container for a screen, component or layout. Put related objects inside it.

tools.title: Section
tools.body: Group regions of the canvas into named sections for organization.

tools.title: Slice
tools.body: Mark a rectangular export region without changing the design's objects.

tools.title: Rectangle
tools.body: Draw a rectangular vector shape; adjust fill, stroke and corner radius afterward.

tools.title: Line
tools.body: Draw a straight line between two points.

tools.title: Arrow
tools.body: Draw a line with an arrowhead for direction or annotation.

tools.title: Ellipse
tools.body: Draw an oval or circle.

tools.title: Polygon
tools.body: Draw a regular polygon and adjust its sides in the properties panel.

tools.title: Star
tools.body: Draw a star and adjust its points and shape properties.

tools.title: Pen
tools.body: Place vector points and handles to draw an editable path.

tools.title: Pencil
tools.body: Draw a freehand vector path.

tools.title: Text
tools.body: Create and edit text on the canvas.

tools.title: Text on a path
tools.body: Place text along an editable vector path.

tools.title: Comment
tools.body: Attach a comment to a location in the design for review.

tools.title: Pick color
tools.body: Sample a color from visible content.

tools.title: Shape builder
tools.body: Combine or remove regions formed by overlapping selected shapes.

tools.title: Sticky note
tools.body: Place a sticky note on a board for a short idea or annotation.

tools.title: Shapes
tools.body: Add a board shape for diagrams or visual organization.

tools.title: Connector
tools.body: Connect board objects with a line that follows their positions.

tools.title: Marker
tools.body: Draw a freehand mark on a board.

tools.title: Highlighter
tools.body: Draw a translucent highlight over board content.

tools.title: Eraser
tools.body: Remove board ink strokes. Check which content is selected before erasing.

tools.title: Stamp
tools.body: Place a stamp on a board to annotate or react to content.
